The second report successfully reviewed all files and found no malicious injections. data.disagreement_analysis: The first model failed to process the LICENSE file due to an API error, forcing an inconclusive package verdict. The second model processed all files successfully and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3) failed to audit the LICENSE file due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should not fail the entire package audit or mark it inconclusive due to an API error on a non-executable file like LICENSE. It should retry or gracefully degrade, allowing the overall verdict to reflect the security status of the actual packaging files.
